title: The TRUTH About Annuities Revealed

scenes.text: More than 1 in 5 Americans believe annuities are the best retirement investment.
scenes.hook_top: ANNUITIES NOT AS GOOD AS YOU

scenes.text: Many annuities come with fees that can reduce your returns significantly.
Investors often overlook that surrender charges can lock them in for years.
Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.

description: Annuities might seem like a safe bet for retirement, but they come with hidden risks and costs. Discover what you need to know before investing! Follow for more financial tips.
